# Udio AI (udioai.lol)

> An AI music studio: describe a song in plain text and Udio AI writes the
> lyrics, music, vocals and mix in seconds, then lets you extend, inpaint and
> remix the result.

This is an English-only music generation site. The home page, pricing page and
legal pages are public; creating and saving songs requires Google sign-in, and
generation is available to accounts with an active subscription.

## Pages

- [Home](https://udioai.lol/): what Udio AI does, example songs from the feed,
  the editing tools, and the live generation queue.
- [Pricing](https://udioai.lol/pricing): Standard, Pro and Ultra plans, monthly
  or annual, billed by Stripe.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://udioai.lol/terms-of-service)
- [Privacy Policy](https://udioai.lol/privacy-policy)

## Key facts

- Product: Udio AI, an AI music generator and editing studio.
- Input: a text prompt (optionally with lyrics, tuning and a reference audio).
- Output: a full song with vocals and instrumentation, extendable and editable
  with Inpaint, Extend, Remix and Upload Song tools.
- Plans: Standard from $10/month, Pro from $30/month, Ultra from $99/month;
  annual billing saves about 20%.
- Sign-in: Google. Payments: Stripe.
